finding: GET/POST /auth/order-returns and POST cancellation require Cognito access-token scope aws.cognito.signin.user.admin. AppAuthService.getAccessToken returns ID token preferentially, so gateway rejects before Lambda.
repair: OrderReturnsService default credential uses existing TokenRefreshService.getValidUserAccessToken; no ID fallback, gateway unchanged

tests.regression: Secure-storage default provider with valid ID and access tokens selects access token on both GET and POST; stale session reply rejected

acceptance: Owner must reopen return receipt screen; no receipt submitted by agent
